title: LoadingState
description: Page, route and section loading: a decorative ProgressIndicator spinner next to a visible label, inside a single polite status region.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text next to the spinner, also its accessible name; `null` shows the spinner alone (named by the "common.loading" message)

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the spinner (`neutral`: the secondary text color)

props.name: vertical
props.description: Stacks the label under the spinner instead of beside it

props.name: overlay
props.description: Covers its container (or the screen, at the root) with a translucent mask and centers the indicator on it
